name: Friendly Cat
detailed_description:
Explore the world and help animals be happy again. Collect gold coins, search for hidden treasures, find a diamond mine. Grow vegetables and fruits. Take care of zoo animals and dinosaurs. Find the favorite items and toys of animals that someone took. Who is behind this? You will find out.

You will be able to communicate with animals using visual language to find out what item or toy they need. When you get close to an animal, it will show you what it needs.

Some animals have objects or toys to trade, but you will only get them if you give them the object they need. Sometimes you will have to think a little how to get the object, and sometimes you will just find it.

That is why you have to travel around the world and look for favorite things and toys for animals. A horseshoe for a horse? No problem - you will find it. Shampoo for a pig? You will find it. But sometimes it is more difficult. How to get to the middle of the lake and get a beach ball for a seal? You will have to think.

Also remember to collect gold coins, look for treasures and diamonds - they will come in handy for buying various items or toys in shops run by little dogs.

But don't worry, when you meet a cat - a friendly cat - it will be easier for you.

So explore and discover the world, look for items and toys for animals, shop at the pet store, make animals happy again and learn the secrets of the colorful world of animals.

Meet a mammoth, a dinosaur, a shark and many, many other animals. And remember - with the help of a friendly cat you will find out who played a trick on the animals and took their favorite items and toys.

So welcome to the world of animals and good luck!
